caption: Kar. 76. Stela
reading: wos : wetñyinoqe(2)li : sori : wetrri m(3)[.]lbsedokeqowi : bero(4)p?ñtpote : terikelowi : (5)yiwo?dtelito : tedḫe(6)lowi : ato : mẖe : psoẖe(7)kete : at : mẖe psiḫ(8)rkete : ḫmlolw : pẖ(9)olkete
notes: Read right to left from 5 rows of the copy; stone lines 1-9 by Griffith's raised numbers. Line 1 'wetd?': the sign after t is a small crossed x with a loop; I read d (same family as the d in tedḫelowi) but it could be ñ. 'noqeli': the slash+curled 3 is read q; the same shape in 'sori' is read s+o (visual '/3' = q or s+o, hand_key trap). Row 1 ends with a small tick after 'wetrri' and row 2 starts without a divider, so 'wetrri' and 'sienses...' may be one word. Line 3 start: first sign hatched (i?). 'nse': n is the ʌ-with-long-tail form. 'ḫkesywi': visual S + long-tailed 3 read k+e (as in terikelowi), could be a. Line 4: '[.]' is a sign drawn in dots with a solid long tail, nothing readable. 'dt?pote': t? is an S with a dot below. 'yiwl?dtesito?': l? is a small ⊢-like sign; final to? is a closed loop with a long tail (to or ḫ). 3-shaped signs (m, ẖ, s) not separable by shape; in 'mẖe' the order m-ẖ is assumed. Final 'ḫmlolẖ?': last sign a flat-topped 3 (ẖ or s).
check_notes: All 18 entries placed (names table A, B, C; formulae A, B, C; Index C). Names table checked in the strip ref_pdf107: A is m[.]lbsedokeqowi (the copy's '<' between d and k is o; the copy's '3 //' before wi is q o). Copy and type agree once the 3-shaped signs and d/ñ are taken from the type.

notes: 8 rows, stone lines 1-10. 'tedḫlowi' has no e between ḫ and l in the copy (Griffith's sic). Line 4 first word heavily hatched: k, se?, t?, r?, i? all hatched; d? is a z-shaped sign. 'sml?d[.]y?i': hatched; [.] is one sign's width of hatching. No divider between terikelowi (end of row 3) and peseto (start of row 4). Line 5 'belo?l?o?ke': the three middle signs are the altered, struck-through group; read as l-o-l-o-shaped strokes, uncertain. 'a?ptetel?wi': first sign an inverted V with long tail (a? or n?), the sign before wi is a small hooked form (l? without visible o stroke). 'wom(6)kise': m is the ')' form; k is a 3 with long tail. 'k?rorolowi': first sign a 2 with long tail (k? or n?). Line 7 'ato?': to is hatched; 'p(8)s?te?': s? is a 3 with a long downstroke (ẖ or m possible), te hatched. 'p(9)s[.]ḫrkete': one hatched sign lost after s. 'ḫm?lol': m? is a ν-shape with two marks above (b/m confusion). 'psol?ke(10)te': l? is a small angular sign (e possible). Final divider present.
check_notes: All 31 entries placed. Names table checked in ref_pdf107: A mlotonqowi (the slash I read o after n is n's own rising stroke; '3 //' is q o), B ḫdḫdiye (the extra small sign I read l? is the d's leg crossing the i). C: the type has ? over two signs (typed smede(?)l(?)i); kept as e? l?. Kept the copy's divider in 'wom(6)nise : krorolowi'. The altered group in beliloke keeps its ?.

caption: Kar. 78. Altar (Kar. Cem., Pl. 20, C. 40164)
labels: sic, above the divider before (15)wi, by line 15
reading: wosi : a(2)soreyi : (3)ñtewitrqowi : dkretri : (4)mq?idt : terikelowi : mlit(5)rq?ide : ted?[.]ḫ?elowi pes(6)to : aki(7)ñtelowi (8)wleke kro(9)rolowi : (10)sekesekiñ : ssimetelo(11)wi : smrso : krorolo : ab(12)solowi : qorbtowi : nb(13)r : wñ(14)li : ipḫetelo : (15)wi : pqorl : ye(16)tmdelo(17)wi : ato mẖe : psiẖete : (18)at mẖe : psḫrkte : (19)ḫmlol : yidotedik(20)te : ẖẖll : (21)psiplte
notes: 11 rows, stone lines 1-21. 'i' in this copy is often a doubled crossed 4 (as in terikelowi). '(3)dtewi?tr...': i? is an H-like crossed sign. Line 5 'ted?[.]ḫ?elowi': hatched stretch after te with a d-like fragment, about one more sign lost, then a hatched c (ḫ?). No divider at the row ends after 'elowi' and after 'dtel?owi'. 'ani(7)dtel?owi': visual S + 2-with-tail read a, then a 3 whose long tail runs right (n?), same group as Kar. 77 line 4; l? is hatched. 'wl?eke': small hooked sign after w (l or i). Line 13 'nb(13)r': first sign ℛ with long tail (n), b is ν-shaped. 'wñ?(14)li': crossed x (ñ or d). The divider after 'li' is a single dot. 'i?pḫetelo : (15)wi': the divider inside the word is marked sic by Griffith. 'psore'/'s?m?rso'/'ab(12)solowi': slash + 3 read s+o (could be q). 'psiẖ?ete': a bold 3 with a down-left tail. 3-shaped signs (m, ẖ, s) not separable by shape in several places, marked ?.
check_notes: All 54 entries placed. Names table checked in ref_pdf107 (A ñtewitrqowi, B mlitrq?ide, C mq?idt). Formula C checked in ref_pdf066: the sign after te is the λ-shaped d, so yidotedikte (as Index C), not yidotenikte. Index B gives peseto and krorolowi; the copy shows pesto and krorolo, as Index A and C have them. pqorl kept with the copy's separate o slash (Index B pqorl; Index A and C typed pqrl). D2 first word taken as ẖẖll from the table (Index C typed ẖsll). The damaged father's title 'ted?[.]ḫ?elowi' has no entry and stays as in step 1.

'(4)s?s?idt' is the same group as Kar. 78 line 4. 'pestol?': a small hooked sign follows to before the divider. 'kditowi' occurs twice (lines 5 and 7) and 'kdilowi' once; k is a 3 with a long tail (a possible). Line 6 'bel?o?lokel?': the two signs after be are drawn in dots (damaged), read l? o?; a small sign follows ke before the divider. 's?ñ?mde(10)se': second sign an X with loop (ñ or d).
